note: The compare page lists all 9 consumer credit cards in div.tile-selector (plain HTML, 24 Nov 2026). Tiles have names and data-product-type slugs but no product-page href. Official product URLs from the Credit Cards menu, confirmed on the English sitemap: /credit-cards/products/unionpay-dual-currency-classic/ (UnionPay Dual Currency Card), /visa-gold/ (Visa Gold Card), /unionpay-dual-currency-diamond/ (Pulse Dual Currency Card; page heading HSBC Pulse UnionPay Dual Currency Diamond Credit Card), /premier-mastercard/ (Premier MasterCard; page heading HSBC Premier Mastercard), /visa-signature/ (Visa Signature Card), /student-visa-gold/ (Visa Gold Card for Students), /visa-platinum/ (HSBC easy Credit Card; page heading also names Visa Platinum Credit Card), /red/ (Red Credit Card), /everymile/ (EveryMile Credit Card). The catalogue at /credit-cards/ features 4 cards only. The menu is duplicated in the header, so a menu-link selector would double-count. Payment, instalment and Octopus pages are not cards. Debit cards are under /debit-cards/ and were excluded. robots.txt disallows all PDFs, including the Key Facts Statement and Bank Tariff guide, so fee amounts that exist only in those files cannot be fetched.
